name: Scarecrow
descr: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.

data.motivesAndTactics: Pull yourself together, scratch and claw

features.name: Made of Straw
features.text: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

features.name: Terror Vision
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing **2d8** magic damage and making them _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.
